facts.text: Alila Ubud sits on a hillside above the Ayung River, surrounded by jungle canopy.
facts.excerpt: Perched above the sacred Ayung River, Alila Ubud offers a secluded hillside retreat surrounded by jungle canopy and calming stillness.

facts.text: The resort blends contemporary design with traditional Balinese architecture.
facts.excerpt: Blending contemporary design with traditional Balinese architecture

facts.text: The rooms and villas overlook the Ayung River Valley and are designed to resemble a Balinese village.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the rolling hills of the Ayung River Valley, the 56 rooms and 18 Villas of Alila Ubud offer a secluded retreat, designed to resemble a Balinese village.

facts.text: Lower-floor rooms have individual garden terraces and high-floor rooms have spacious balconies with jungle views.
facts.excerpt: Revel in individual garden terraces in all of the lower-floor rooms, and spacious balconies with jungle views in the high-floor rooms.

facts.text: The Two Bedroom Villa is the resort's largest, with a private pool, outdoor tubs and a separate dining area.
facts.excerpt: the Two Bedroom Villa is the resort’s largest, with a private pool, outdoor tubs, and a separate dining area.

facts.text: The Valley Villa has valley views, an outdoor tub in a lotus pond and alang-alang roofing.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy breathtaking valley views, an outdoor tub in a lotus pond, and the comfort of alang-alang roofing.

facts.text: The Terrace Tree Villa is a treehouse-like retreat atop the valley with a terrace looking over the rainforest canopy.
facts.excerpt: Terrace Tree Villa, a treehouse-like retreat atop the valley. Enjoy sunrises over banyan and coconut trees. Relax on a terrace with the rainforest canopy view.

facts.text: The Pool Villa has a private pool and an open-air tub among lotus, and includes in-villa check-in and check-out.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy in a secluded 120-sqm villa with a private pool, surrounded by gardens and trees. Relax in an open-air tub among lotus, or on terrace daybeds. Includes swift in-villa check-in/out.

facts.text: Deluxe rooms have a private garden terrace and back courtyard, an outdoor bathtub and shower, and garden and valley views.
facts.excerpt: private garden terrace and back courtyard, an outdoor bathtub and shower, and sweeping garden and valley views.

facts.text: The resort has an infinity pool set among lush greenery.
facts.excerpt: Swim laps or lounge at our 25-metre infinity pool, nestled among the hotel property’s lush greenery and surrounded by luxurious sunbeds.

facts.text: Spa Alila treatments include the lulur body scrub, an ancient village remedy that originates from Bali rice farmers.
facts.excerpt: Choose from locally inspired treatments like the lulur body scrub—an ancient village remedy that originates from Bali rice farmers

facts.text: Spa Alila combines contemporary wellness products and services with ancient Asian healing techniques.
facts.excerpt: At Spa Alila, we combine contemporary wellness products and services with ancient Asian healing techniques and age-old beauty recipes.

facts.text: A weekly wellness program includes sunrise yoga, Qi Gong, Tai Chi and rice paddy walks.
facts.excerpt: During our weekly wellness ritual, begin with sunrise yoga, where body and spirit align with the first light of day, or discover the flowing grace of Qi Gong and Tai Chi

facts.text: The Journey Through Purification and Prayer experience visits a Brahmin compound for a Melukat blessing from a Balinese high priest.
facts.excerpt: During the Melukat blessing, the priest pours blessed water over you—a simple yet powerful act meant to clear the mind and restore balance.

facts.text: Guests can work alongside a farmer in the rice fields on the Roots of Bali experience.
facts.excerpt: Experience the joy, rhythm, and beauty of bringing rice to the table as you work with a farmer to cultivate this most precious nutrient.

facts.text: Guests can craft their own silver piece side by side with a local Balinese silversmith.
facts.excerpt: Gain a newfound appreciation for the work of silversmiths as you forge bonds—literally and figuratively—with local artisans while you work side-by-side to craft your own piece of wearable art.

facts.text: A guided cycling tour rides through rice terraces to the traditional Payangan market and a local family compound.
facts.excerpt: Stop at the traditional Payangan market to immerse in local culture.

facts.text: Plantation Restaurant serves Asian specialties, including an Indonesian rijsttafel, in a wantilan-style pavilion with an alang-alang roof overlooking the Ayung River valley.
facts.excerpt: Dine beneath an airy Balinese wantilan-style pavilion, framed by soaring coconut pillars and a traditional alang-alang roof, as the Ayung River valley provides a captivating backdrop

facts.text: The Cabana Lounge is a daytime social space that serves evening cocktails.
facts.excerpt: The Cabana Lounge is an intimate social space for daytime relaxation, while mood lighting on the two-story-high Karangasem Terracotta Brick features wall that inspires an air of sophistication, perfect for enjoying evening cocktails.

facts.text: Ubud, the center of Balinese arts and culture, is 15 minutes from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Just 15 minutes from the resort stands Ubud, a city that has reigned as the center of Balinese arts and culture for more than a century.

facts.text: Most of the team is recruited from neighboring banjars, and all produce is bought locally.
facts.excerpt: Alila Ubud takes great pride in recruiting most of our team members from neighboring banjars. We also purchase all our produce locally

facts.text: The resort is about 40 kilometers from I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport.
facts.excerpt: I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS)40.3 kilometers

facts.text: Barong Dance Night, a traditional Balinese performance with local food, is held every Monday.
facts.excerpt: Experience Barong Dance Night at Alila Ubud, where traditional Balinese performance and authentic local flavours come together in a memorable cultural evening. Every Monday

facts.text: Nearby attractions include the Tegalalang rice terraces, Mount Batur and the Goa Gajah cave.
facts.excerpt: Discover the terraced rice fields of Tegalalang, trek through deep jungle to reach the summit of Mount Batur, and marvel at the 9th-century cave of Goa Gajah
